output.summary: A prostrate annual-to-perennial herb considered native in most places and on every continent except Antarctica, but introduced in Venezuela and the Falkland Islands and absent from southern Asia. It inhabits springs, streams and seasonally wet grassland, sometimes forming mats or floating. In Spain and Portugal, wild plants are gathered and eaten as salad, though they are not cultivated.
output.edibilityNote: Wild plants are gathered for salad in Spain and Portugal but are not currently cultivated.
